    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split('\n')
    T = int(input[0])
    index = 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(T):
        n, k = map(int, input[index].split())
        if k > n or k < 0:
            results.append('-1')
        elif k == n:
            results.append(' '.join(map(str, range(1, n + 1))))
        else:
            perm = list(range(1, n + 1))
            for i in range(k):
                perm[i] = i + 1
            if n - k >= 2:
                perm[k], perm[k + 1] = perm[k + 1], perm[k]
            else:
                results.append('-1')
                continue
            results.append(' '.join(map(str, perm)))
        index += 1
    print('\n'.join(results))
